papers.title: Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with Intermediate Stroke Risk.
papers.journal: The New England journal of medicine
papers.authors: Kim D, Lee YS, Shim J, Yu HT, Park J, Park JK, et al.
papers.citation: Kim D, Lee YS, Shim J, Yu HT, Park J, Park JK, et al.. Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with Intermediate Stroke Risk.. N Engl J Med. 2026 Sep 24;395(12):1155-1165. doi: 10.1056/NEJMoa2607978 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Current U.S. and European guidelines recommend oral anticoagulation as a class IIa indication in patients with atrial fibrillation at intermediate risk for stroke; however, evidence from randomized trials is needed.

METHODS:
We conducted a multicenter, open-label, adjudicator-masked superiority trial in South Korea involving patients with atrial fibrillation and an intermediate risk of stroke (a score of 1 in men and 2 in women on the CHADS-VASc scale; range, 0 to 9, with higher scores indicating a greater risk of stroke). Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) therapy or no anticoagulation. The primary end point was a composite of stroke, systemic embolism, major bleeding, or death from cardiovascular causes at 24 months.

RESULTS:
Of 1803 patients who underwent randomization, 902 were assigned to receive DOAC therapy and 901 were assigned to receive no anticoagulant therapy. The mean age of the patients was 60.4 years, and 23.7% were women. At 24 months, a primary end-point event had occurred in 4 patients (cumulative incidence, 0.5%) in the DOAC group and in 13 (cumulative incidence, 1.5%) in the no-anticoagulant group (difference, -1.0 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -2.0 to -0.1; P = 0.03; hazard ratio, 0.31; 95% CI, 0.10 to 0.94). Stroke occurred in 3 patients (cumulative incidence, 0.3%) in the DOAC group and in 10 (cumulative incidence, 1.1%) in the no-anticoagulant group. The incidence of systemic embolism and major bleeding appeared to be similar in the two trial groups, and no deaths from cardiovascular causes occurred in either group. Serious adverse events occurred in 80 patients (8.9%) in the DOAC group and in 84 (9.3%) in the no-anticoagulant group.

CONCLUSIONS:
Among patients with atrial fibrillation at intermediate risk for stroke, DOAC therapy led to a lower risk of stroke, systemic embolism, major bleeding, or death from cardiovascular causes at 24 months than no anticoagulation. (Funded by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, South Korea, and others; SINGLE-AF ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04437654.).
papers.titleJa: 中等度の脳卒中リスクを伴う心房細動に対する抗凝固療法
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】現在の米国および欧州のガイドラインでは、クラス IIa の適応症として経口抗凝固療法を推奨している (無作為化比較試験 (RCT) / N = 1,803例)
【方法】われわれは、心房細動を有し、脳卒中リスクが中程度（CHADS-VAScスケールで男性のスコアが1、女性のスコアが2、範囲は0〜9、スコアが高いほど脳卒中リスクが高いことを示す）を有する患者を対象とした、多施設共同、非盲検、裁定者マスクの優越性試験を韓国で実施した。患者は、直接経口抗凝固薬（DOAC）療法を受ける群と抗凝固療法を受けない群に1:1の比率で無作為に割り当てられた。主要エンドポイントは、24ヵ月時点での脳卒中、全身性塞栓症、大出血、または心血管疾患による死亡の複合であった
【結果】ランダム化を受けた1,803人の患者のうち、902人はDOAC療法を受けるように割り当てられ、901人は抗凝固療法を受けないように割り当てられた。  患者の平均年齢は60.4歳で、23.7%が女性であった。  24ヵ月時点で、主要エンドポイントイベントはDOAC群の患者4名（累積発生率、0.5%）、抗凝固薬非投与群の患者13名（累積発生率、1.5%）で発生した（差、-1.0パーセントポイント、95%信頼区間[CI]、-2.0～-0.1、P=0.03、ハザード比、 0.31; 95% CI、0.10 ～ 0.94)。  脳卒中は、DOAC群では3名（累積発生率、0.3%）、抗凝固剤非投与群では10名（累積発生率、1.1%）に発生した。 全身性塞栓症と大出血の発生率は 2 つの試験グループで同様であるようであり、どちらのグループでも心血管疾患による死亡は発生しなかった。  重篤な有害事象は、DOAC 群では 80 名（8.9%）、抗凝固薬非投与群では 84 名（9.3%）に発生しました
【結論】脳卒中リスクが中程度の心房細動患者において、DOAC療法は抗凝固療法を行わなかった場合に比べ、24カ月時点で脳卒中、全身性塞栓症、大出血、心血管疾患による死亡のリスクが低かった

papers.title: Intramyocardial injection of allogeneic human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes in advanced ischemic heart failure: an early-stage randomized trial.
papers.authors: Zhang H, Menasche P, Fan J, Gao L, Luo H, Xue Y, et al.
papers.citation: Zhang H, Menasche P, Fan J, Gao L, Luo H, Xue Y, et al.. Intramyocardial injection of allogeneic human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes in advanced ischemic heart failure: an early-stage randomized trial.. Nat Med. 2026 Sep 19;32(9):3331-3338. doi: 10.1038/s41591-026-04605-1 doi.
papers.abstract: A treatment for heart failure that could promote myocardial regeneration has long been sought. Here we conduct the HEAL-CHF trial (n = 20; 18 male and 2 female), in which patients with advanced heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (left ventricular ejection fraction ≤45%) were randomized to receive intramyocardial injections of allogeneic human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes or were uninjected. Both groups received concomitant coronary artery bypass grafting. The primary endpoint was safety, defined as the incidence of sustained ventricular tachycardia during the 1- to 6-month postoperative period and tumorigenicity at 12 months of follow-up. Neither sustained ventricular tachycardia nor tumorigenicity was observed in either patient group. Early post-transplantation ventricular arrhythmias occurred in patients in the cell therapy group during the first 4 weeks, as all 10 patients in this group developed accelerated idioventricular rhythm, typically emerging 5 to 7 days post-transplantation. Clinically significant ventricular tachycardia (>140 bpm), which occurred in 2 patients, peaked at 2 to 3 weeks post-procedure and resolved completely after cardioversion. Secondary efficacy analyses indicated that cell transplantation provided significantly greater improvements in 6-min walk distance, global myocardial perfusion (as assessed by the summed rest score on Tc single-photon emission computed tomography-computed tomography) and relative wall thickening, compared with coronary artery bypass grafting alone. No significant between-group differences were observed for left ventricular ejection fraction, left ventricular volumes, myocardial scar size, New York Heart Association functional class or Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire scores at 12 months. In view of the arrhythmic events observed, future studies will need to determine the risk-to-benefit ratio associated with human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocyte therapy. ClinicalTrials.gov registration: NCT03763136 .

papers.summaryJa:
【概要】心筋の再生を促進できる心不全の治療法が長年求められてきました (無作為化比較試験 (RCT) / N = 20例)
【方法】今回我々は、HEAL-CHF試験（n = 20、男性18名、女性2名）を実施する。この試験では、駆出率が低下した進行性心不全患者（左心室駆出率≤45％）を、同種ヒト人工多能性幹細胞由来心筋細胞の心筋内注射を受ける群と注射を受けない群に無作為に割り付けた
【結果】今回我々は、HEAL-CHF試験（n = 20、男性18名、女性2名）を実施する。この試験では、駆出率が低下した進行性心不全患者（左心室駆出率≤45％）を、同種ヒト人工多能性幹細胞由来心筋細胞の心筋内注射を受ける群と注射を受けない群に無作為に割り付けた。主要評価項目は、術後1～6か月間の持続性心室頻拍の発生率として定義される安全性と、12か月の追跡調査における腫瘍原性であった
【結論】不整脈事象を考慮して、将来の研究では、ヒト人工多能性幹細胞由来心筋細胞療法に関連するリスク対利益の比を決定する必要がある
papers.abstractJa: 心筋の再生を促進できる心不全の治療法が長年求められてきました。  今回我々は、HEAL-CHF試験（n = 20、男性18名、女性2名）を実施する。この試験では、駆出率が低下した進行性心不全患者（左心室駆出率≤45％）を、同種ヒト人工多能性幹細胞由来心筋細胞の心筋内注射を受ける群と注射を受けない群に無作為に割り付けた。  両方のグループは冠状動脈バイパス移植術を同時に受けました。  主要評価項目は、術後1～6か月間の持続性心室頻拍の発生率として定義される安全性と、12か月の追跡調査における腫瘍原性でした。  どちらの患者グループでも持続性心室頻拍や腫瘍原性は観察されませんでした。 移植後早期の心室性不整脈は、細胞療法グループの患者で最初の 4 週間に発生しました。このグループの 10 人の患者全員が固有心室調律の加速を発症し、通常は移植後 5 ～ 7 日で出現しました。  2人の患者で発生した臨床的に重大な心室頻拍（>140bpm）は、処置後2〜3週間でピークに達し、電気的除細動後に完全に解消しました。  二次有効性解析では、冠状動脈バイパス移植単独と比較して、細胞移植が6分間の歩行距離、全体的な心筋灌流（Tc単一光子放出コンピュータ断層撮影法とコンピュータ断層撮影法の合計安静スコアによって評価）、および相対的な壁肥厚において有意に大きな改善をもたらしたことが示された。 12ヵ月時点の左心室駆出率、左心室容積、心筋瘢痕サイズ、ニューヨーク心臓協会の機能分類、またはミネソタ州心不全生活アンケートスコアについては、群間に有意差は観察されなかった。  観察された不整脈事象を考慮して、将来の研究では、ヒト人工多能性幹細胞由来心筋細胞療法に関連するリスク対利益の比を決定する必要がある。  ClinicalTrials.gov 登録: NCT03763136 。

papers.title: Impact of anxiety and depression in patients with atrial fibrillation: Insights from 2 international prospective registries.
papers.authors: Rossi M, Bucci T, Tartaglia E, Askarinejad A, Rigutini AG, Tse HF, et al.
papers.citation: Rossi M, Bucci T, Tartaglia E, Askarinejad A, Rigutini AG, Tse HF, et al.. Impact of anxiety and depression in patients with atrial fibrillation: Insights from 2 international prospective registries.. Heart Rhythm. 2026 Oct 04;23(10):e2488-e2498. doi: 10.1016/j.hrthm.2026.06.001 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Limited data are available on the impact of anxiety and/or depression on clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

OBJECTIVE:
The purpose of this study was to compare clinical characteristics and outcomes between patients with AF with and without anxiety/depression.

METHODS:
Post hoc analysis of 2 prospective registries from Europe and the Asia-Pacific. Patients were classified as asymptomatic or symptomatic for anxiety/depression. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause death and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACEs). Secondary outcomes included all-cause death, MACE, major bleeding, and individual MACE components. Cox models estimated hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Sensitivity analyses were performed by symptom severity and across clinically relevant subgroups.

RESULTS:
Of 12,614 patients (mean age 69 ± 12 years; 38% female), 4825 (38.3%; mean age 69 ± 12; 48% female) were symptomatic for anxiety/depression. Symptomatic patients with anxiety/depression were more often female, were European, and had a higher prevalence of AF-related symptoms and heart failure. After a median follow-up of 569 days (interquartile range, 365-735 days), symptomatic patients had a higher risk of the composite outcome (HR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.10-1.45), all-cause death (HR, 1.31; 95% CI, 1.12-1.55), MACE (HR, 1.44; 95% CI, 1.19-1.74), and cardiovascular death (HR, 1.87; 95% CI, 1.41-2.47). Risk increased with symptom severity; no significant interaction was observed by geographic region or other analyzed subgroups.

CONCLUSION:
In patients with AF, anxiety/depression symptoms were associated with worse clinical outcomes, with a stronger association observed in those with moderate-to-severe symptoms. These findings highlight the need for greater awareness of psychological assessment within AF management.
papers.titleJa: 心房細動患者における不安とうつ病の影響: 2 つの国際的な前向き登録からの洞察
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】心房細動 (AF) 患者の臨床転帰に対する不安および/またはうつ病の影響について入手できるデータは限られている (前向き研究 (Prospective) / N = 12,614例)
【方法】この研究の目的は、不安/うつ病を伴う心房細動患者と不安/うつ病を伴わない心房細動患者の臨床的特徴と転帰をの比較であった
【結果】Cox モデルは、ハザード比 (HR) と 95% 信頼区間 (CI) を推定しる。結果：患者12,614人（平均年齢69±12歳、女性38％）のうち、4825人（38.3％、平均年齢69±12歳、女性48％）に不安/うつ病の症状があった
【結論】これらの調査結果は、心房細動管理における心理的評価の意識を高める必要性を浮き彫りにしている
papers.abstractJa: 心房細動 (AF) 患者の臨床転帰に対する不安および/またはうつ病の影響について入手できるデータは限られている。 目的: この研究の目的は、不安/うつ病を伴う心房細動患者と不安/うつ病を伴わない心房細動患者の臨床的特徴と転帰をの比較であった。 方法: ヨーロッパとアジア太平洋地域の 2 つの見込みレジストリの事後分析。 患者は、不安/うつ病に関して無症候性または症候性として分類された。 主要転帰は、全死因死亡と重大な心血管イベント（MACE）の複合であった。 副次転帰には、全死因死亡、MACE、大出血、および個々の MACE 要素が含まれる。 Cox モデルは、ハザード比 (HR) と 95% 信頼区間 (CI) を推定しる。 感度分析は、症状の重症度ごとに、また臨床的に関連するサブグループ全体にわたって実行された。 結果：患者12,614人（平均年齢69±12歳、女性38％）のうち、4825人（38.3％、平均年齢69±12歳、女性48％）に不安/うつ病の症状があった。 不安/うつ病を伴う症状のある患者は女性であることが多く、ヨーロッパ人であり、AF関連の症状や心不全の有病率が高かった。 中央値569日（四分位範囲、365～735日）の追跡調査後、症状のある患者は複合転帰（HR、1.26; 95% CI、1.10～1.45）、全死因死亡（HR、1.31; 95% CI、1.12～1.55）、MACE（HR、1.44; 95%）のリスクが高かった。 CI、1.19-1.74）、心血管死（HR、1.87; 95% CI、1.41-2.47）。 症状の重症度に応じてリスクは増加しる。地理的地域または他の分析されたサブグループでは、有意な相互作用は観察されなかった。 結論: AF 患者では、不安/抑うつ症状は臨床転帰の悪化と関連しており、中等度から重度の症状を持つ患者ではより強い関連が認めた。 これらの調査結果は、心房細動管理における心理的評価の意識を高める必要性を浮き彫りにしている

papers.title: Risk of Stroke and TIA With Pulsed Field Compared With Radiofrequency Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation.
papers.authors: Ferro EG, d'Avila A, Reynolds MJ, Villarreal D, Nelson J, Yoon J, et al.
papers.citation: Ferro EG, d'Avila A, Reynolds MJ, Villarreal D, Nelson J, Yoon J, et al.. Risk of Stroke and TIA With Pulsed Field Compared With Radiofrequency Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation.. Circulation. 2026 Sep 29;154(13):1170-1183. doi: 10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.126.081092 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Pulsed field ablation (PFA) of atrial fibrillation has been rapidly adopted, partly because of safety expectations compared with thermal ablation. Comparative safety data between the 2 modalities remain limited.

METHODS:
We conducted a prospective registry analyzing consecutive atrial fibrillation ablations at a high-volume US academic center between 2022 and 2026. The primary end point was stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA) within 30 days, independently adjudicated by blinded neurologists. Secondary end points included death and other procedural complications. Propensity score methods with inverse probability of treatment weighting were used to balance differences in patient characteristics. Differences in the procedural workflow of PFA versus radiofrequency ablation (RFA) were evaluated with exploratory mediation analyses.

RESULTS:
A total of 4221 ablation procedures (2077 RFA and 2144 PFA: 68.7% Farawave, 23.3% Sphere 9, 6.9% Varipulse, 0.7% PulseSelect) was performed by 12 operators. papers.title: Clinical Vulnerability Refines Rhythm-Related Outcomes in Older Patients Undergoing Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation: An Observational Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Mohsen Y, Fernholz J, Steffens L, Novikov I, Sabareesan S, Vatsaraj I, et al.
papers.citation: Mohsen Y, Fernholz J, Steffens L, Novikov I, Sabareesan S, Vatsaraj I, et al.. Clinical Vulnerability Refines Rhythm-Related Outcomes in Older Patients Undergoing Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation: An Observational Cohort Study.. J Arrhythm. 2026 Oct 25;42(5):e70461. doi: 10.1002/joa3.70461 doi.
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION:
Chronological age is often considered when selecting patients for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, but age alone may not identify which older patients are most likely to require recurrent rhythm-related care after pulmonary vein isolation (PVI).

METHODS:
We conducted a single-center observational study of consecutive patients undergoing PVI. The principal registry cohort assessed the same-center recurrence-related rhythm-intervention endpoint, defined as the first post-index repeat PVI or electrical cardioversion. A nested active 2022 cohort assessed broader actively ascertained recurrence. Age was analyzed as < 50, 50-74, and ≥ 75. An exploratory elderly vulnerability score assigned one point each for documented persistent AF, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and valve disease/surgery.

RESULTS:
The registry cohort included 2559 patients and 580 same-center rhythm-intervention events. Event rates increased across age groups: 14.2% in patients aged < 50, 20.8% in those aged 50-74, and 29.8% in those aged ≥ 75. Age ≥ 75 was independently associated with higher risk versus age 50-74 in adjusted registry Cox analysis, HR: 1.35, 95% CI: 1.12-1.64, = 0.002, after 90-day blanking, HR: 1.37, 95% CI: 1.12-1.69, = 0.002, and in the active cohort, HR: 1.46, 95% CI: 1.01-2.11, = 0.042. Elderly Score 0 patients were not significantly different from patients aged 50-74 in registry analysis, aHR: 1.13, 95% CI: 0.79-1.63, = 0.5, or active analysis, aHR: 1.01, 95% CI: 0.49-2.09, = 0.975, whereas Score ≥ 2 identified higher event burden in both the registry cohort, aHR: 1.85, 95% CI: 1.45-2.35, < 0.001, and active cohort, aHR: 1.95, 95% CI: 1.23-3.12, = 0.005.

CONCLUSION:
Age ≥ 75 was associated with a higher rate of same-center recurrence-related rhythm interventions after PVI, but the risk varied substantially. Clinical vulnerability, not chronological age alone, may better inform counseling and selection of older patients.

papers.title: Preemptive mechanical circulatory support in ventricular tachycardia ablation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.journal: Journal of interventional cardiac electrophysiology : an international journal of arrhythmias and pacing
papers.authors: Zhang DT, Nerkar M, Mahmud S, Singh A, Almasry IO, Fan R, et al.
papers.citation: Zhang DT, Nerkar M, Mahmud S, Singh A, Almasry IO, Fan R, et al.. Preemptive mechanical circulatory support in ventricular tachycardia ablation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.. J Interv Card Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 22;:. doi: 10.1007/s10840-026-02445-0 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
The benefit of preemptive mechanical circulatory support (MCS) for ventricular tachycardia (VT) ablation remains unclear. This meta-analysis compared the efficacy and safety of preemptive MCS to standard care for VT ablation.

METHODS:
An unrestricted literature search of PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science identified studies on preemptive MCS for VT ablation. MCS included percutaneous left ventricular assist devices or extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. The primary endpoint was all-cause mortality; secondary endpoints included VT recurrence, procedural time, procedural complications (vascular access, bleeding, stroke, pericardial effusion, heart failure, myocardial infarction), and 30-day major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).

RESULTS:
Eight studies with 2,262 patients (414 with MCS, 1,848 without) were included. Mean follow-up was 15.8 months, mean age was 62.6 years, 12.5% were women, and mean PAINESD scores were 15.7 in the MCS group and 10.5 in the no-MCS group. There was no significant difference in all-cause mortality (OR 1.58, 95% CI 0.60-4.19, p = 0.36, I²=81%) or VT recurrence (OR 1.03, 95% CI 0.68-1.56, p = 0.90, I²=46%). Preemptive MCS was associated with longer procedural times (mean difference 46.0 min, 95% CI 11.1-80.8, p = 0.01, I²=86%), more procedural complications-driven by vascular access and pericardial effusion (OR 2.25, 95% CI 1.26-4.03, p = 0.006, I²=33%). Thirty-day MACE was not uniformly defined across studies and was therefore not pooled.

CONCLUSIONS:
Preemptive MCS was not associated with a significant difference in all-cause mortality or VT recurrence in patients undergoing VT ablation but was associated with longer procedures, and more procedural complications. The certainty of evidence was very low, reflecting the observational study design, baseline imbalance between groups, and heterogeneity; these findings do not preclude the selective use of MCS in high-risk patients and require confirmation in randomized trials.

papers.citation: Reed MJ, Goodacre S, Weir CJ, Dinsmore L, Nugent A, Kennel T, et al.. Immediate Ambulatory Electrocardiographic Monitoring in Syncope.. N Engl J Med. 2026 Aug 31;:. doi: 10.1056/NEJMoa2605812 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
In patients with syncope who present to the emergency department for evaluation, diagnosing an underlying cardiac arrhythmia remains difficult.

METHODS:
We conducted an open-label, randomized, controlled trial at 45 hospitals in the United Kingdom to assess the effects of 14-day cardiac monitoring on diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes among patients with syncope. Adults with syncope that remained unexplained after an evaluation in the emergency department were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to undergo 14-day ambulatory electrocardiographic (ECG) monitoring (the intervention group) or to receive the standard care provided for patients with unexplained syncope at each participating site (the standard-care group). The primary outcome was the mean number of patient-reported episodes of syncope at 1 year.

RESULTS:
A total of 2234 patients underwent randomization: 1123 were assigned to the intervention group and 1111 to the standard-care group. The mean age of the patients was 58.3 years, and 52.1% were male. After the exclusion of patients who did not complete any follow-up, a total of 1970 patients (1004 in the intervention group and 966 in the standard-care group) were included in the primary analysis. The mean (±SD) number of patient-reported syncope episodes at 1 year was 1.37±5.10 in the intervention group and 1.58±8.56 in the standard-care group (incidence rate ratio, 0.89; 95% confidence interval, 0.68 to 1.18; P = 0.42). A total of 49 adverse events were reported in the intervention group, and 8 adverse events were reported in the standard-care group, with 1 serious adverse event in each group.

CONCLUSIONS:
Among patients with syncope that remained unexplained after evaluation in the emergency department, the use of 14-day ambulatory ECG monitoring did not result in significantly fewer patient-reported syncope episodes at 1 year than standard care. (Funded by the British Heart Foundation and National Health Service Research Scotland; ASPIRED ISRCTN Registry number, ISRCTN10278811.).
papers.titleJa: 失神時の即時外来心電図モニタリング
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】心血管疾患治療における臨床アプローチの検証 (観察研究・その他 / N = 2,234例)
【方法】われわれは英国の45の病院で非盲検ランダム化対照試験を実施し、失神患者の診断、治療、転帰に対する14日間の心臓モニタリングの効果を評価した。救急部門での評価後に原因不明の失神を患った成人を、14日間の外来心電図（ECG）モニタリングを受ける群（介入群）と、各参加施設で原因不明の失神の患者に提供される標準治療を受ける群（標準治療群）に1:1の比率で割り当てた。主要評価項目は、患者が報告した1年間の失神エピソードの平均数であった
【結果】合計 2,234 人の患者が無作為化を受け、1,123 人が介入群に、1,111 人が標準治療群にに割り付けた。  患者の平均年齢は58.3歳で、52.1%が男性であった。  追跡調査を完了しなかった患者を除外した後、合計1970人の患者（介入群1004人、標準治療群966人）が一次解析の対象となった。  1年間で患者が報告した失神エピソードの平均（±SD）数は、介入群で1.37±5.10回、標準治療群で1.58±8.56回であった（発生率比、0.89、95％信頼区間、0.68～1.18、P＝0.42）。 介入グループでは合計 49 件の有害事象が報告され、標準治療グループでは 8 件の有害事象が報告され、各グループで 1 件の重篤な有害事象がと報告された
【結論】救急部門での評価後も原因不明の失神患者のうち、14日間の外来心電図モニタリングの使用は、標準治療に比べて1年後に患者が報告する失神エピソードの有意な減少をもたらさなかった

papers.title: Arrhythmic Risk Stratification According to LGE Corridors and Genetics in Nonischemic Dilated Cardiomyopathy.
papers.authors: Ramos-López N, Mora-Ayestarán N, Ochoa JP, Claver E, Gómez González C, Poel E, et al.
papers.citation: Ramos-López N, Mora-Ayestarán N, Ochoa JP, Claver E, Gómez González C, Poel E, et al.. Arrhythmic Risk Stratification According to LGE Corridors and Genetics in Nonischemic Dilated Cardiomyopathy.. Circulation. 2026 Sep 08;:. doi: 10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.126.080608 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Fibrosis assessed through late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) in cardiac magnetic resonance imaging and genetics have emerged as risk markers of ventricular arrhythmias in nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy. Conduction corridors detected within LGE (ie, LGE corridors) have been associated with ventricular arrhythmias in ischemic cardiomyopathy. This study sought to evaluate major ventricular arrhythmic events (MVAs) according to the presence of LGE corridors combined with high-risk genotypes (HRGs) in nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy.

METHODS:
We studied consecutive patients with nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy from 22 European centers who had undergone genetic testing and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging.

RESULTS:
Among 925 patients (mean age, 54.5 years [interquartile range, 43.7-63.9 years]; 64% men; mean left ventricular ejection fraction, 37.6% [26.9%-44.8%]; LGE in 24.3%), LGE corridors were present in 160 patients (17.3%), and HRG in 119 (12.9%). After a median follow-up of 5.4 years (interquartile range, 3.3-7.7), 95 patients (10.3%) experienced an MVA. In multivariable competing-risk analysis adjusted for left ventricular ejection fraction and extent of LGE, the number of LGE corridors and HRGs were independently associated with MVA (subdistribution hazard ratio, 1.25 [95% CI, 1.11-1.42]; <0.001; and subdistribution hazard ratio, 2.28 [95% CI, 1.32-3.96]; =0.003, respectively). An optimal cutoff of ≥4 LGE corridors predicted MVA. A stepwise risk stratification algorithm to predict MVA integrating LGE, the presence of ≥4 LGE corridors, and HRG outperformed left ventricular ejection fraction ≤35%-based classification proposed in guidelines (5-year time-dependent area under the curve, 0.72 [95% CI, 0.65-0.78] versus 0.57 [95% CI, 0.51-0.64]; =0.001), showing a progressive increase in arrhythmic risk across categories (Gray test <0.001), and allowing clinically meaningful arrhythmic risk classification.

CONCLUSIONS:
LGE corridors and HRGs provide additive value for arrhythmic risk stratification in patients with nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy. These findings support MVA multiparametric prediction over the traditional left ventricular ejection fraction ≤35% threshold.
papers.titleJa: 非虚血性拡張型心筋症における LGE 回廊と遺伝学に基づく不整脈リスクの層別化
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】心臓磁気共鳴画像法および遺伝学における遅発ガドリニウム増強（LGE）によって評価される線維症は、非虚血性拡張型心筋症における心室不整脈のリスクマーカーとして浮上している。 LGE内で検出される伝導コリドー（すなわち、LGEコリドー）は、虚血性心筋症における心室不整脈と関連している。この研究では、非虚血性拡張型心筋症における高リスク遺伝子型 (HRG) と組み合わされた LGE コリドーの存在に応じて、主要な心室不整脈イベント (MVA) を評価することを目的としました (観察研究・その他 / N = 925例)
【方法】私たちは、遺伝子検査と心臓磁気共鳴画像法を受けたヨーロッパの22のセンターからの非虚血性拡張型心筋症患者を連続して研究しました
【結果】925人の患者（平均年齢、54.5歳[四分位範囲、43.7～63.9歳]、64％が男性、平均左室駆出率、37.6％[26.9％～44.8％]、24.3％にLGE）中、160人の患者（17.3％）にLGE回廊が存在し、119人にHRGが存在した。 (12.9%)。  追跡期間中央値5.4年（四分位範囲3.3～7.7）後、95人の患者（10.3％）がMVAを経験した。  左心室駆出率とLGEの範囲を調整した多変量競合リスク分析では、LGEコリドーとHRGの数は独立してMVAと関連していた（部分分布ハザード比、1.25 [95% CI、1.11-1.42]; <0.001; および部分分布ハザード比、2.28 [95% CI、1.32-3.96]; =0.003、それぞれ)。  4 つ以上の LGE コリドーの最適なカットオフにより、MVA が予測された。 LGE、4つ以上のLGEコリドーの存在、およびHRGを統合したMVAを予測するための段階的リスク階層化アルゴリズムは、ガイドラインで提案されている左室駆出率≤35%に基づく分類を上回りました（5年間の時間依存曲線下面積、0.72 [95% CI、0.65-0.78] vs 0.57 [95% CI、 0.51-0.64]; =0.001）、カテゴリー全体で不整脈リスクが漸進的に増加していることを示し（グレーテスト <0.001）、臨床的に意味のある不整脈リスク分類が可能になる
【結論】LGE コリドーと HRG は、非虚血性拡張型心筋症患者の不整脈リスク層別化に付加価値をもたらしる

papers.title: Safety and Efficacy of Left Atrial Ablation After Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion in High-Bleeding-Risk Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Multicenter Analysis from the PROCEED-AF Ablation Registry.
papers.journal: Europace : European pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac electrophysiology : journal of the working groups on cardiac pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac cellular electrophysiology of the European Society of Cardiology
papers.authors: Kaplan RM, du Fay de Lavallaz J, Heeger CH, Oral H, Yoder M, Schaack D, et al.
papers.citation: Kaplan RM, du Fay de Lavallaz J, Heeger CH, Oral H, Yoder M, Schaack D, et al.. Safety and Efficacy of Left Atrial Ablation After Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion in High-Bleeding-Risk Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Multicenter Analysis from the PROCEED-AF Ablation Registry.. Europace. 2026 Sep 25;:. doi: 10.1093/europace/euag277 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS:
Patients with left atrial appendage (LAAO) devices are increasingly referred for AF ablation, yet anticoagulation strategies remain uncertain. The goal of this study was to evaluate the safety and efficacy of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) in patients with pre-existing LAAO devices and to describe patterns in anticoagulation management after ablation in this unique population.

METHODS:
We collected data from 14 centers worldwide on patients with prior LAAO devices undergoing AF ablation. Each site provided clinical characteristics, procedural details, and information on complications and arrhythmia outcomes. Data were aggregated and analyzed centrally to evaluate procedural safety, efficacy, and variability in management strategies.

RESULTS:
A total of 198 patients (age 70 years, 37% female, 42% paroxysmal AF) with prior LAAO were included. Ablation was performed a median of 271 days after LAAO. After ablation, 84% of patients were on oral anticoagulation (OAC), most commonly for 2-3 months. Bleeding complications on OAC occurred in 6.7% of patients at a median of 20 (13, 70) days after ablation. Stroke or TIA occurred in 5 patients (2.6% of cases) within the follow-up period with 2 occurrences (1% of cases) the day after ablation. There were 2 cases of new or worsened peri-device leak after ablation.

CONCLUSION:
In a large, international registry of patients undergoing catheter ablation for AF with pre-existing LAAO devices, ablation was feasible and device related complications were rare Despite higher bleeding risk in an LAAO population, 84% of patients with prior LAAO tolerated short term OAC post-ablation with bleeding events at expected rates for this population.
papers.titleJa: 心房細動を伴う高出血リスク患者における経皮的左心耳閉塞後の左心房アブレーションの安全性と有効性: PROCEED-AF アブレーション レジストリからの多施設解析
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】そして目的: (観察研究・その他 / N = 198例)
【方法】私たちは、以前に LAAO デバイスを使用して AF アブレーションを受けた患者に関するデータを世界中の 14 のセンターからを解析した。各サイトでは、臨床的特徴、手順の詳細、合併症と不整脈の転帰に関する情報を提供しました。データは集約され、管理戦略における手順の安全性、有効性、変動性を評価するために一元的に分析された
【結果】過去にLAAOを患った合計198人の患者（年齢70歳、女性37％、発作性AF42％）が含まれた。アブレーションは、LAAO 後中央値 271 日に実施した。アブレーション後、患者の 84% が経口抗凝固療法 (OAC) を受けており、最も一般的な期間は 2 ～ 3 か月間であった。 OAC による出血合併症は、アブレーション後中央値 20 (13、70) 日で患者の 6.7% に発生しました。追跡期間中に脳卒中またはTIAが5人の患者(症例の2.6%)で発生し、アブレーション翌日に2件(症例の1%)が発生した。アブレーション後にデバイス周囲のリークが新たに発生した、または悪化したケースが 2 件ありました
【結論】既存の LAAO デバイスを使用して心房細動に対するカテーテルアブレーションを受けている患者の大規模な国際登録では、アブレーションは実行可能であり、デバイス関連の合併症はまれであった。LAAO 集団では出血リスクが高いにもかかわらず、LAAO 患者の 84% が、この集団で予想される割合で出血イベントを伴うアブレーション後の短期間の OAC に耐えました

papers.title: Virtual Heart-Based Prediction of Ablation Outcomes in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation Based on Non-Pulmonary Vein Drivers.
papers.authors: Hwang T, Kwon OS, Huh J, Ahn D, Im KS, Lee HM, et al.
papers.citation: Hwang T, Kwon OS, Huh J, Ahn D, Im KS, Lee HM, et al.. Virtual Heart-Based Prediction of Ablation Outcomes in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation Based on Non-Pulmonary Vein Drivers.. Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 25;:e014266. doi: 10.1161/CIRCEP.125.014266 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Clinical outcomes of driver-targeted ablation in persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) have been inconsistent, underscoring the need for virtual heart-based approaches to characterize AF driver dynamics and guide ablation strategies. We used virtual heart models from a large persistent AF cohort to define electrophysiological features of extra-pulmonary vein drivers associated with rhythm outcomes after AF ablation.

METHODS:
We analyzed left atrial virtual heart models integrating cardiac computed tomography and electroanatomical maps in 165 patients with persistent AF from the CUVIA-AF2 study (Clinical Usefulness of Virtual Ablation Guided Catheter Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation 2). During a 34-second virtual AF simulation, stable phase singularities (PSs) were identified by PS lasting ≥2 s within a 10-mm diameter. Dominant frequency (DF) was assessed over 3 consecutive 6-second intervals to evaluate temporal stability. The maximal slope of the action potential duration restitution curve was derived via virtual ramp pacing (200-120 ms). All markers were evaluated across 6 extra-pulmonary vein regions. Associations among stable PS, DF, maximal slope of the action potential duration restitution curve, low-voltage area (<0.5 mV), and 1-year rhythm outcomes were analyzed.

RESULTS:
Stable PS at extra-pulmonary vein regions was observed in 124 (75%) patients; of these, 43 (34.7%) showed stable DF, and 81 (65.3%) had meandering DF. papers.title: Impact of Interelectrode Spacing on Ventricular Tachycardia Substrate Mapping: Insights Into 3-Dimensional Characteristics of the Arrhythmogenic Substrate.
papers.authors: Iioka Y, Komatsu Y, Shinoda Y, Hanaki Y, Oda Y, Hayashi Y, et al.
papers.citation: Iioka Y, Komatsu Y, Shinoda Y, Hanaki Y, Oda Y, Hayashi Y, et al.. Impact of Interelectrode Spacing on Ventricular Tachycardia Substrate Mapping: Insights Into 3-Dimensional Characteristics of the Arrhythmogenic Substrate.. JACC Clin Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 24;:. doi: 10.1016/j.jacep.2026.08.021 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Re-entrant ventricular tachycardia (VT) circuits often involve 3-dimensional activation across the endocardium, epicardium, and mid-myocardium, highlighting the importance of comprehensive substrate assessment. Wider interelectrode spacing may incorporate broader-field electrical components that are less apparent on conventional closely spaced recordings.

OBJECTIVES:
This study sought to investigate the electrophysiological impact of interelectrode spacing on substrate mapping and its potential implications for 3-dimensional features of VT substrate.

METHODS:
Sixty-eight high-density substrate maps from 35 patients undergoing catheter ablation for scar-related VT were retrospectively analyzed. Closely spaced (2-mm) and widely spaced (8-mm) bipolar electrograms were simultaneously acquired using a decapolar catheter and used to generate closely and widely spaced bipolar electrode maps (CEM and WEM).

RESULTS:
Compared with CEM, WEM, which incorporates a greater contribution of far-field components, demonstrated higher bipolar amplitudes, a greater prevalence of multicomponent electrograms, and a lower prevalence of split potentials (all P < 0.01). Lines of block delineated by split potentials on CEM were frequently attenuated or no longer apparent on WEM because the corresponding electrograms appeared fragmented and lacked a distinct split configuration. In an exploratory analysis of 6 VTs with evaluable activation maps, activation gaps were larger with closely than widely spaced bipolar mapping (32.5% vs 20.0%; P = 0.03). In 4 VTs, widely spaced recordings identified diastolic or presystolic far-field potentials not evident with closely spaced recordings.

CONCLUSIONS:
Widely spaced bipolar electrograms may provide complementary functional information beyond that obtained with conventional near-field recordings by incorporating broader-field electrical components, thereby offering additional insight into the potential 3-dimensional characteristics of the arrhythmogenic substrate.
papers.titleJa: 心室頻拍基質マッピングに対する電極間間隔の影響: 不整脈原性基質の 3 次元特性についての洞察
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】リエントラント心室頻拍 (VT) 回路には心内膜、心外膜、心筋中央部にわたる 3 次元の活性化が関与することが多く、包括的な基質評価の重要性が強調されている。電極間の間隔が広いと、従来の狭い間隔の記録では目立たなかった、より広いフィールドの電気コンポーネントを組み込むことができる。目的: この研究は、基質マッピングに対する電極間間隔の電気生理学的影響と、VT 基質の 3 次元特徴に対するその潜在的な影響を調査することを目的としました (観察研究・その他 / N = 35例)
【方法】瘢痕関連 VT のカテーテル アブレーションを受けている 35 人の患者からの 68 枚の高密度基質マップを遡及的に分析しました。十極カテーテルを使用して、密な間隔 (2 mm) と広い間隔 (8 mm) の双極電位図を同時に取得し、密な間隔と広い間隔の双極電極マップ (CEM および WEM) を生成するために使用しました
【結果】CEM と比較して、遠方界成分のより大きな寄与を組み込んだ WEM は、より高い双極性振幅、多成分心電図のより高い蔓延、および分割電位のより低い蔓延を実証しました (すべて P < 0.01)。 CEM 上の分割電位によって描写されるブロックの線は、対応する電気記録図が断片化して見え、明確な分割構成を欠いているため、WEM では頻繁に減衰するか、または明白ではなくなりました。評価可能な活性化マップを使用した 6 つの VT の探索的分析では、活性化ギャップは、間隔が広い双極マッピングよりも狭い場合の方が大きかった (32.5% 対 20.0%; P = 0.03)。 4 つの VT では、間隔の広い記録により、狭い間隔の記録では明らかではなかった拡張期または収縮前遠方場電位が特定された
【結論】VT 基板の 3 次元特徴について

papers.title: Pediatric Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia: Clinical Characteristics, Genetic Spectrum, and Outcomes in a Multicenter Cohort.
papers.authors: Aydemir MM, Nalbant M, Karacan M, Aydin Ü, Tunca Şahin G, Demirel Başgöze A, et al.
papers.citation: Aydemir MM, Nalbant M, Karacan M, Aydin Ü, Tunca Şahin G, Demirel Başgöze A, et al.. Pediatric Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia: Clinical Characteristics, Genetic Spectrum, and Outcomes in a Multicenter Cohort.. JACC Clin Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 22;:. doi: 10.1016/j.jacep.2026.08.020 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is a rare inherited arrhythmia with a high risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in childhood.

OBJECTIVES:
This study sought to characterize pediatric CPVT and evaluate contemporary therapeutic outcomes, including left cardiac sympathetic denervation (LCSD) and bilateral cardiac sympathetic denervation (BCSD).

METHODS:
This retrospective multicenter study included 92 pediatric patients with CPVT from 3 tertiary centers in Türkiye between 2012 and 2025. Arrhythmic events included aborted cardiac arrest, sudden cardiac death, appropriate implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shocks, arrhythmic syncope, and ventricular tachycardia. Paired preprocedural and postprocedural event rates were compared in patients with an adequate preprocedural observation period.

RESULTS:
Median age at symptom onset was 9.25 years (IQR: 5.88-12.0), and median age at diagnosis was 11.6 years (IQR: 8.64-14.41). Among 87 genetically tested patients, 74 (85.1%) had a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant; ryanodine receptor 2 and calsequestrin 2 variants were identified in 41 (47.1%) and 24 (27.6%), respectively. Fifty patients underwent sympathetic denervation (LCSD, n = 25; BCSD, n = 25). In the paired cohort (n = 35), median arrhythmic event rate decreased from 3.20 events/year (IQR: 1.74-8.76) before LCSD/BCSD to 0.00 events/year (IQR: 0.00-1.35) during the first 2 postprocedural years (P < 0.001). First 2-year event rates did not differ significantly between procedures. Seven patients died; documented treatment nonadherence was present in all.

CONCLUSIONS:
LCSD/BCSD was associated with a substantial reduction in arrhythmic burden, but observational treatment allocation and center-specific management preclude conclusions regarding comparative effectiveness. Sustained treatment adherence remains essential.

papers.title: First-in-human experience from RESET-AF (Rapid onE-Shot Electroporation Trial for Atrial Fibrillation).
papers.journal: Journal of interventional cardiac electrophysiology : an international journal of arrhythmias and pacing
papers.authors: Gould PA, Thomas SP, Ahmad W, Qian PC, Aryana A
papers.citation: Gould PA, Thomas SP, Ahmad W, Qian PC, Aryana A. First-in-human experience from RESET-AF (Rapid onE-Shot Electroporation Trial for Atrial Fibrillation).. J Interv Card Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 17;:. doi: 10.1007/s10840-026-02434-3 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS:
Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is increasingly used to treat patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). The RESET-AF was a single-arm, first-in-human, clinical trial of AF ablation using a novel, single-shot PFA system (ElePulse, CRC EP, Tustin, CA, USA), trial registration ACTRN12622001523796 (Date registered 8th December 2022).

METHODS:
In 36 consecutively-enrolled patients (57 ± 11 years, 69% male) with symptomatic paroxysmal (n = 22) and persistent (n = 14) AF, pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) was performed using this catheter, guided by 3D mapping. All patients underwent remapping at 3 months to confirm PVI durability. Patients were followed at 6 and 12 months with clinical review, Holter monitoring and electrocardiography. The primary efficacy and safety endpoints included a freedom from recurrent AF at 12 months > 50% and serious adverse events (SAE) at 7 and 30 days 50% and 6-month freedom from AF > 60%.

RESULTS:
All endpoints were achieved in the entire study cohort. There was 1 SAE (renal impairment which resolved with conservative management) with a total SAE rate of 2.8%. One patient was lost to follow-up at 12 months with a primary efficacy endpoint of 92% (32/35 patients). papers.title: First Latin American retrospective registry of cardiac ablation in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients. A LAHRS registry.
papers.journal: Journal of interventional cardiac electrophysiology : an international journal of arrhythmias and pacing
papers.authors: Moltedo JM, Cuesta A, Vidal F, Iturralde P, Márquez-Murillo MF, Levinstein M, et al.
papers.citation: Moltedo JM, Cuesta A, Vidal F, Iturralde P, Márquez-Murillo MF, Levinstein M, et al.. First Latin American retrospective registry of cardiac ablation in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients. A LAHRS registry.. J Interv Card Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 29;:. doi: 10.1007/s10840-026-02442-3 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Catheter ablation has been proven as an effective and safe therapy for tachyarrhythmias in pediatric and congenital heart disease (CHD) patients. Although there are international registries on the use of catheter ablation in these populations, none of them include Latin American countries.

OBJECTIVES:
To assess the clinical characteristics of pediatric and congenital heart disease patients undergoing catheter ablation procedures. Data obtained includes types of arrhythmias, techniques, success, complications and recurrence rates.

MATERIALS AND METHODS:
A descriptive and analytical retrospective observational study was performed. A closed coded online form available for 6 months was used. All electrophysiologists who practice pediatric electrophysiology in Latin America and were identified in a previous LAHSR's survey were invited to participate through Latin American Heart Rhythm Society (LAHRS) electronic media ( https://lahrs.org/ ). Participation was not mandatory, it was not encouraged by any economic or material goods, and an informed consent for the use of the data was required. Consecutive electrophysiological catheter procedures were included in children under 18 years of age or patients with CHD, regardless age, between 2017 and 2021.

RESULTS:
Twenty physicians from 8 Latin American countries participated. A total of 1778 procedures were reported, 53% were male, mean age was 12.4 ± 5.1 years and 8.5% had congenital heart disease. An ablation was attempted in 87% of the patients, using a non-irrigated tip radiofrequency catheter in 68% of them, and a 3-D mapping system in 29%. Radiofrequency was the most commonly used energy source in 98% of the cases. The most frequent substrates were accessory pathways in 69.5% (61% were manifest), followed by AV nodal reentry in 16.5% and ectopic atrial tachycardia in 4%. Additionally, there were 3.8% atrial flutter, 3.8% ventricular tachycardias, 1.2% premature ventricular contractions. Ablation was considered acutely successful in 93% of the cases. Mean total procedural time was 92.1 ± 36.8 min and mean total fluoroscopy time was 16.3 ± 9.4 min. Complication rate was 1.8% and included complete AV block in 3 patients (0.2%). No deaths were reported. The recurrence rate was 8.5%.

CONCLUSIONS:
In this first exclusively pediatric and congenital heart disease retrospective registry of catheter ablation in Latin America, a high rate of success and low incidence of complications was observed. This is in concordance with previously reported registries from other latitudes, proving that ablation is an effective and safe therapy in this group of patients.

papers.title: Safety and performance of vibration-assisted extraction of chronic cardiac implantable electronic device leads: A preclinical ovine study.
papers.authors: Ramot Y, Tomer O, Zilberman Barzilai D, Willenz U, Beer O, Tov YS, et al.
papers.citation: Ramot Y, Tomer O, Zilberman Barzilai D, Willenz U, Beer O, Tov YS, et al.. Safety and performance of vibration-assisted extraction of chronic cardiac implantable electronic device leads: A preclinical ovine study.. Heart Rhythm. 2026 Oct 02;23(10):e2343-e2351. doi: 10.1016/j.hrthm.2026.06.042 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Transvenous extraction of chronic cardiac implantable electronic device leads is challenged by fibrotic adhesions and procedural risks. Novel technologies aim to improve safety and efficacy. A high-frequency mechanical vibration system aims to disrupt adhesions.

OBJECTIVE:
This study aimed to evaluate the initial safety, performance, and usability of a novel vibration-assisted lead extraction system in a preclinical Good Laboratory Practice ovine model.

METHODS:
9 leads implanted for >2 years (range 2.9-5.25 years) were extracted from 6 sheep using the vibration system under fluoroscopy. The internal lumen of the leads was used to deliver a customized locking stylet. The stylet was used to deliver vibration energy to the lead, applied for up to 20 minutes/animal. Assessments included procedural success, lead integrity, intraprocedural monitoring, 3-day clinical follow-up, laboratory tests, necropsy, and histopathology (heart, lungs, central veins).

RESULTS:
Procedural success (lead removal) was 100% without adjunctive tools: external cutting sheath was not required for adhesion dissection in all of the cases. Lead release occurred within ∼1 minute in 8 of 9 leads. Primary safety endpoints were met: no central vein or myocardial perforation and no pulmonary embolism. No blood pressure drops, significant arrhythmias, or worsening tricuspid regurgitation occurred. 1 lead fracture (1 of 9) resulted in a retained distal screw (<1 cm) associated with mild localized myocardial necrosis. Anchor device malfunctions required intraprocedural replacement in 2 cases.

CONCLUSION:
Vibration-assisted extraction of chronic cardiac implantable electronic device leads was feasible with a remarkable acute safety profile in this ovine model, meeting primary safety endpoints. The procedure was characterized by notable technical simplicity and rapid lead release via the internal lumen, successfully obviating the requirement for potentially hazardous external cutting sheaths. Lead fracture and anchor malfunctions indicate areas for further technological assessment and clinical trial.
papers.titleJa: 慢性心臓植込み型電子機器リードの振動補助摘出の安全性と性能: ヒツジの前臨床研究
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】慢性心臓植込み型電子機器リードの経静脈的抜去は、線維性癒着や処置上のリスクによって課題が生じている (観察研究・その他 / N = 2例)
【方法】新しい技術は、安全性と有効性の向上を目指している
【結果】補助ツールなしで手術の成功 (リード除去) は 100% であった。すべての症例で癒着剥離に外部切断シースは必要ありませんであった。この手順は、顕著な技術的単純さと内部ルーメンを介した迅速なリード放出を特徴としており、潜在的に危険な外部切断シースの要件を回避することに成功しました
【結論】リードの破損とアンカーの機能不全は、さらなる技術評価と臨床試験の余地があることを示している
papers.abstractJa:
【背景】
 慢性心臓植込み型電子機器リードの経静脈的抜去は、線維性癒着や処置上のリスクによって課題が生じている。 新しい技術は、安全性と有効性の向上を目指している。 高周波機械振動システムは、癒着を破壊することを目的としている。 
【目的】
 この研究は、前臨床適正実験基準ヒツジモデルにおける新しい振動補助リード抽出システムの初期の安全性、性能、および使いやすさを評価することを目的としました。 
【方法】
 2 年以上（範囲 2.9 ～ 5.25 年）埋め込まれた 9 本のリードを、X 線透視下で振動システムを使用して 6 頭の羊から抜き取った。 リードの内腔は、カスタマイズされたロッキング スタイレットを送達するために使用された。 スタイレットを使用してリードに振動エネルギーを与え、1 匹あたり最大 20 分間適用しました。 評価には、手術の成功、リードの完全性、手術中のモニタリング、3日間の臨床フォローアップ、臨床検査、剖検、および病理組織学（心臓、肺、中心静脈）が含まれる。 
【結果】
 補助ツールなしで手術の成功 (リード除去) は 100% であった。すべての症例で癒着剥離に外部切断シースは必要ありなかった。 リードの解放は、9 つ​​のリードのうち 8 つで約 1 分以内に発生しました。 主要な安全性評価項目は満たされた：中心静脈または心筋穿孔がないこと、および肺塞栓症がないこと。 血圧低下、重大な不整脈、三尖弁逆流の悪化は発生しなかった。 1 つのリード骨折 (9 件中 1 件) では、軽度の局所的な心筋壊死を伴う遠位スクリューの残存 (<1 cm) が発生しました。 アンカーデバイスの誤動作により、2 件のケースで処置中の交換が必要になりました。 
【結論】
 このヒツジモデルでは、慢性心臓植込み型電子機器リードの振動支援による抜去は実現可能であり、主要な安全性エンドポイントを満たし、顕著な急性安全性プロファイルを示しました。 この手順は、顕著な技術的単純さと内部ルーメンを介した迅速なリード放出を特徴としており、潜在的に危険な外部切断シースの要件を回避することに成功しました。 リードの破損とアンカーの機能不全は、さらなる技術評価と臨床試験の余地があることを示している

We report a case series of 3 critically ill patients with refractory incessant ventricular fibrillation (VF) who underwent catheter ablation using high-density mapping of the Purkinje system during ongoing VF, combined with targeted Purkinje denetworking and myocardial substrate modification. These 

RESULTS:
suggest that, in carefully selected patients, combined Purkinje-targeted ablation and substrate modification may provide a life-saving rescue strategy for otherwise refractory incessant VF.

papers.abstract: The aim of the AFA-ARC (Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Academic Research Consortium) initiative is to reexamine trial design and the safety and effectiveness end points for pivotal clinical trials evaluating catheter ablation for the treatment of symptomatic atrial fibrillation to provide meaningful and interpretable data to support regulatory decision-making. Beginning in July 2024, a group of international experts began meeting regularly both virtually together and separately in working groups (group 1 effectiveness end points; group 2 safety end points; and group 3 trial design and report forms), with one in-person meeting held in April 2025, and revisions of draft proposals from January 2025 to February 2026. The Food and Drug Administration Office of Cardiovascular Devices at the Center for Devices and Radiological Health provided input throughout the revision and proposal process. A patient advocate participated in the in-person meeting and during the revision phase. Heart Rhythm Society leadership was involved throughout the process and in the revision phase. Industry representatives were sent drafts of the proposed manuscripts during the revision phase before submission. This document represents contributions from each of the 3 Working Groups. The Heart Rhythm Society endorsed this document. This AFA-ARC document proposes revised effectiveness and safety end points, study design, and report forms for studies evaluating AF ablation in patients with symptomatic paroxysmal, persistent, or longstanding persistent AF.

papers.title: Do Stimulants Promote Arrhythmic Risk: Insights From a Human-Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell-Derived Cardiomyocyte Model.
papers.authors: Arslanova A, Wong S, Franciosi S, Tibbits GF, Prondzynski M, Sanatani S
papers.citation: Arslanova A, Wong S, Franciosi S, Tibbits GF, Prondzynski M, Sanatani S. Do Stimulants Promote Arrhythmic Risk: Insights From a Human-Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell-Derived Cardiomyocyte Model.. J Arrhythm. 2026 Oct 24;42(5):e70479. doi: 10.1002/joa3.70479 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Stimulant medications are widely prescribed for ADHD. Although generally considered safe, their use in patients with underlying cardiac conditions remains a concern due to potential arrhythmic risk.

OBJECTIVE:
To evaluate the effects of commonly prescribed stimulants on key electrophysiological parameters associated with arrhythmia risk in chamber-specific human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs).

METHODS:
Atrial and ventricular hiPSC-CMs were plated on a multielectrode array (MEA) platform and exposed to clinically relevant plasma concentrations of methylphenidate, dextroamphetamine, atomoxetine, caffeine, or the β-agonist isoproterenol. Extracellular field potentials were recorded over 48 h to assess acute and prolonged effects on conduction velocity (CV), beat rate (BR), and corrected field potential duration (FPDc).

RESULTS:
CV was largely preserved across all stimulant conditions in both atrial and ventricular hiPSC-CMs, while isoproterenol produced a modest early increase. All stimulants transiently elevated BR during the first hour of exposure, followed by a progressive decline over time. Isoproterenol and caffeine induced robust and sustained increases in BR, confirming model responsiveness. FPDc was prolonged by all stimulant compounds, most prominently by atomoxetine, consistent with its known I inhibitory properties. Isoproterenol produced a rate-dependent FPDc shortening, particularly in hiPSC-vCMs.

CONCLUSION:
At clinically relevant plasma concentrations, stimulants modulated automaticity and repolarization but had minimal impact on conduction in hiPSC-CMs. The preservation of CV suggests that these compounds are unlikely to alter myocardial conduction at therapeutic doses. The observed effects on BR and FPDc warrant further mechanistic studies to understand how these changes may contribute to arrhythmia risk in susceptible populations.

papers.summaryJa:

papers.journal: Journal of interventional cardiac electrophysiology : an international journal of arrhythmias and pacing
papers.authors: Sundaram S, Palmeri N, Alyesh D, Cerbin L, Sundaram K, Rappaport A, et al.
papers.citation: Sundaram S, Palmeri N, Alyesh D, Cerbin L, Sundaram K, Rappaport A, et al.. Monitored anesthesia care versus general anesthesia for balloon-in-basket pulsed-field ablation of atrial fibrillation: an age-matched analysis of procedural timing and acute procedural outcomes.. J Interv Card Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 25;:. doi: 10.1007/s10840-026-02443-2 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
General anesthesia (GA) has been the preferred sedation strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF) catheter ablation in the United States, in part because pulsed-field ablation (PFA) systems cause skeletal muscle stimulation and discomfort that can be poorly tolerated under lighter sedation. A recently introduced balloon-in-basket (BiB) PFA system (VOLT) has been reported to produce less muscle stimulation and pain, potentially allowing Monitored Anesthesia Care (MAC) instead of GA. Whether MAC offers procedural efficiency advantages without compromising ablation efficacy in this context has not been well characterized.

OBJECTIVE:
To compare procedural timing, ablation efficacy, and safety between MAC and GA in patients undergoing BiB PFA (VOLT) for AF, using an age-matched design.

METHODS:
We retrospectively analyzed 39 consecutive MAC cases and a pool of 83 GA cases undergoing VOLT BiB PFA from a two-site electrophysiology registry. Each MAC patient was matched 1:1 to the nearest age available GA patient yielding 39 age-matched controls. Six different time intervals were collected: total room time, pre-procedure setup time, core procedure time, post-procedure turnover time, transseptal-to-left atrial (LA) sheath-out (dwell) time, and ablation catheter dwell time. Total ablation lesions delivered, acute procedural success (isolation of all four pulmonary veins), and procedural complications were also compared. Group comparisons were then made. In addition, EP laboratory facility cost savings and scheduling opportunity cost associated with the observed difference in total room time, using published EP/procedural-suite per-minute cost estimates were also determined.

RESULTS:
Total room time (103.5 ± 20.0 vs. 126.2 ± 33.1 min; p = 0.0004), pre-procedure setup time (33.4 ± 10.0 vs. 50.3 ± 28.0 min; p = 0.0007), and post-procedure turnover time (14.8 ± 9.3 vs. 21.4 ± 8.3 min; p = 0.0030) were significantly shorter with MAC. Core procedure time (55.3 ± 20.5 vs. 55.3 ± 23.9 min), transseptal-to-LA-sheath-out time (34.2 ± 12.9 vs. 35.7 ± 18.5 min) did not differ significantly between groups (both p ≥ 0.62). Ablation catheter dwell time was modestly longer with MAC (27.7 ± 11.9 vs. 24.2 ± 15.5 min; p = 0.036). Total ablation lesions delivered (17.6 ± 5.1 vs. 18.8 ± 7.2, p = 0.68) and acute procedural success (39/39 [100%] vs. 39/39 [100%]) were similar between MAC and GA, with no procedural complications in either group. One MAC case (2.6%) was converted to general anesthesia interprocedurally for coughing attributed to airway secretions. Applying published EP/procedural-suite per-minute cost estimates ($29-$60/minute) to the observed 22.7-min reduction in total room time, MAC was associated with an estimated $658-$1,362 in facility cost savings per case, with potential opportunity cost benefit for additional case scheduling.

CONCLUSION:
In an age-matched cohort undergoing BiB PFA (VOLT) for AF, MAC was associated with shorter total room time, pre-procedure setup time, and post-procedure turnover time than GA, with no difference in ablation lesion delivery, acute success, or complications. Anesthesia related time savings with MAC appear concentrated in room logistics rather than the ablation procedure itself, with no detectable difference in acute procedural outcomes in this small cohort, supporting MAC as a reasonable alternative to GA for BiB PFA.

papers.abstract: Pulsed field ablation has rapidly reshaped the landscape of atrial fibrillation ablation by offering a nonthermal, tissue-selective alternative to conventional thermal energy. This review highlights the scientific foundations, preclinical evidence, and engineering advances that established pulsed field ablation as a safer, faster, and more precise technology. We discuss how irreversible electroporation achieves myocardial selectivity, the pivotal studies that confirmed preservation of nearby structures, and the evolution of modern catheter systems designed for efficient and durable lesion creation. As pulsed field ablation platforms continue to mature, they are redefining procedural safety standards and expanding therapeutic possibilities in cardiac electrophysiology.

papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
The variable loop circular catheter has been shown to be a safe, effective pulsed field ablation catheter for atrial fibrillation treatment. After the commercial launch of the initial waveform (Seq1), a new waveform (Seq2) was developed that reduces electrode surface temperature and ablation delivery time (20-3.8 seconds). This study compares the safety and efficacy of Seq1 versus Seq2 across 2 irrigation rates and 2 dosing conditions.

METHODS:
Twenty-four Yorkshire pigs were treated with pulsed field ablation using the variable loop circular catheter. Subjects were randomized into 3 pulse recipe/irrigation arms (Seq1, Seq1, and Seq 2 ). Each group was split into a 1× nominal and a 2×-dose group, resulting in 6 total study groups. Animals were monitored for 28±2 days postablation for follow-up remapping procedures before euthanization. Gross necropsy and histopathology were performed on day 28±2.

RESULTS:
In all groups, 100% acute and chronic pulmonary vein isolation effectiveness was observed, as indicated by transmural, circumferential, pulmonary vein lesions with no evidence of collateral injury. Transmurality in the left atrial appendage, LA roof, and posterior wall was 75% to 100% across all groups and absent at the mitral isthmus. No catheter thrombus/char was observed at Seq2 or Seq1. With Seq1, thrombus/char occurred in 25% (1×) and 100% (2×). Hemolysis and myocardial injury marker changes were similar between all groups, with a notable increase in the 2× groups. On echocardiography, Seq2 microbubbles were rated as few or none, while Seq1 and Seq1 were mostly rated moderate or shower.

CONCLUSIONS:
Consistently durable pulmonary vein isolation was observed across all groups, including Seq1, Seq2, and Seq1 across both dosing conditions. Seq2 was associated with a reduced ablation delivery time (3.8 seconds), zero catheter thrombus formation, and few microbubbles. Higher irrigation flow in Seq1 also mitigated catheter thrombus formation but did not reduce microbubble generation.

【方法】24 頭のヨークシャー豚を、可変ループ円形カテーテルを使用したパルスフィールド アブレーションで治療しました。被験者は、3 つのパルス レシピ/灌注アーム (Seq1、Seq1、および Seq 2) に無作為にに割り付けた。各グループは、名目上の 1 倍の用量グループと 2 倍の用量のグループに分割された
【結果】すべてのグループにおいて、側副傷害の証拠のない経壁性、周囲性、肺静脈病変によって示されるように、急性および慢性肺静脈隔離効果が 100% を認めた。左心耳、LA屋根、および後壁における貫壁性は、すべてのグループにわたって75%〜100%であり、僧帽弁峡部には存在しなかった。 Seq2 または Seq1 ではカテーテル血栓/炭化物は観察されなかった。 Seq1 では、血栓/炭化物が 25% (1x) と 100% (2x) で発生しました。溶血および心筋損傷マーカーの変化はすべてのグループ間で同様であったが、2x グループで顕著に増加しました。心エコー検査では、Seq2 のマイクロバブルはほとんどまたはまったくないとを評価したが、Seq1 と Seq1 はほとんどが中程度またはシャワー程度とを評価した
【結論】両方の投与条件にわたって、Seq1、Seq2、および Seq1 を含むすべてのグループにわたって、一貫して耐久性のある肺静脈隔離が認めた

papers.title: PFKFB2 Gates a Relationship Between Cardiac Glycolytic Regulation and Electrophysiological Function.
papers.authors: Harold KM, Blankenship HE, Minor K, Mulligan A, Loveland B, Lee CF, et al.
papers.citation: Harold KM, Blankenship HE, Minor K, Mulligan A, Loveland B, Lee CF, et al.. PFKFB2 Gates a Relationship Between Cardiac Glycolytic Regulation and Electrophysiological Function.. Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol. 2026 Sep 23;:e014860. doi: 10.1161/CIRCEP.126.014860 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
The cardiac isoform of PFKFB2 (phosphofructokinase-2/fructose 2,6-bisphosphatase) is the heart's strongest glycolytic regulator but is degraded in the absence of insulin signaling. This makes PFKFB2 loss critical to understand in metabolic heart disease, of which impaired insulin signaling is a hallmark. Prolongation of the QT interval, risk of arrhythmia, and sudden cardiac death are also augmented in metabolic heart disease, raising a question as to whether crosstalk between glycolytic dysregulation and electrophysiological dysfunction exists.

METHODS:
We, therefore, assessed the impact of PFKFB2 loss on cardiac electrophysiology using a cardiomyocyte-specific PFKFB2 knockout mouse model (cKO) and litter-matched controls. To do so, we employed electrocardiography in the fed state and following 12 hours of fasting, examining physiology both at baseline and in the presence of an acute stimulant stress. To further investigate the arrhythmia mechanism, we used patch-clamp electrophysiology and IonOptix Ca transient measurements in ventricular cardiomyocytes isolated from controls and cKO hearts.

RESULTS:
The hearts of cKO mice exhibited prolonged repolarization, marked by QT and action potential duration prolongations. This occurred with impaired Ca reuptake and increased spontaneous Ca release events in ventricular cardiomyocytes. The latter were upregulated via O-GlcNAcylation, a posttranslational modification enhanced in the fed state in cKO hearts. Ultimately, these changes culminated in ventricular tachyarrhythmia in cKO mice, which was enhanced in the fed relative to the fasted state.

CONCLUSIONS:
These data suggest that in the presence of sufficient glucose availability, cardiac glycolytic dysregulation at the phosphofructokinase nexus is sufficient to promote cardiac electrophysiological instability.
papers.titleJa: PFKFB2 は心臓の解糖調節と電気生理学的機能の間の関係をゲートしる
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】PFKFB2 の心臓アイソフォーム (ホスホフルクトキナーゼ-2/フルクトース 2,6-ビスホスファターゼ) は心臓の最も強力な解糖調節因子ですが、インスリンシグナル伝達がないと分解される。このため、インスリンシグナル伝達の障害が特徴である代謝性心疾患では、PFKFB2 欠損を理解することが重要となる。 QT間隔の延長、不整脈のリスク、心臓突然死も代謝性心疾患で増大しており、解糖系調節障害と電気生理学的機能障害との間にクロストークが存在するかどうかという疑問が生じている (観察研究・その他 / 症例数: 不明)
【方法】したがって、我々は、心筋細胞特異的 PFKFB2 ノックアウト マウス モデル (cKO) と同腹仔の対照を使用して、心臓電気生理学に対する PFKFB2 欠損の影響を評価しました。そのために、我々は、摂食状態および12時間の絶食後の心電図検査を採用し、ベースラインと急性刺激性ストレスの存在下の両方で生理機能を調べました。不整脈のメカニズムをさらに調査するために、パッチクランプ電気生理学と、対照心臓およびcKO心臓から単離した心室心筋細胞におけるIonOptix Ca過渡測定を使用しました
【結果】cKO マウスの心臓は、QT および活動電位持続時間の延長を特徴とする長期の再分極を示しました。これは、心室心筋細胞における Ca 再取り込みの障害と自発的 Ca 放出事象の増加によって起こりました。後者は、cKO心臓の摂食状態で増強される翻訳後修飾であるO-GlcNAc化を介して上方制御された。最終的に、これらの変化は cKO マウスの心室頻脈性不整脈を引き起こし、絶食状態に比べて食餌状態で増強された
【結論】これらのデータは、十分なグルコース利用可能性の存在下では、ホスホフルクトキナーゼ結合における心臓の解糖調節異常が心臓の電気生理学的不安定性を促進するのに十分であることを示唆している

papers.title: Targeting trafficking defects in long QT syndrome type 2: a phase 2 clinical study with patient-specific cellular validation.
papers.authors: Crotti L, Dagradi F, Mura M, Giovenzana FLF, Lorusso MG, Cerea P, et al.
papers.citation: Crotti L, Dagradi F, Mura M, Giovenzana FLF, Lorusso MG, Cerea P, et al.. Targeting trafficking defects in long QT syndrome type 2: a phase 2 clinical study with patient-specific cellular validation.. Eur Heart J. 2026 Sep 22;:. doi: 10.1093/eurheartj/ehag753 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS:
A major component of long QT syndrome (LQTS) is LQT2 due to pathogenic variants in KCNH2, which frequently cause trafficking defects. Despite progress in therapeutic management, there is an unmet clinical need for mechanism-targeted therapies. It has been previously shown, using patient-specific human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs), that lumacaftor (LUM), currently used for cystic fibrosis, can partially correct hERG trafficking. A single-arm phase 2 study was conducted to determine whether LUM could shorten QTc in LQT2 patients with trafficking defects.

METHODS:
Sixteen adult patients with genetically confirmed trafficking-defective KCNH2 variants were enrolled. Participants were admitted to hospital and received LUM for 7 days under continuous telemetry. QTc was quantified on serial electrocardiograms and 12-lead Holter recordings. For mechanistic correlation, hiPSC-CMs were generated from the first five participants with distinct genetic variants and assessed for hERG maturation and trafficking.

RESULTS:
Overall, lumacaftor produced a significant QTc shortening (P < .001). The per-patient change averaged 31 ± 21 ms. Patients with baseline QTc ≥500 ms exhibited the most substantial effect, with 75% achieving reductions ≥40 ms. No ventricular arrhythmias occurred, and adverse effects were primarily gastrointestinal and self-limited. In hiPSC-CMs, LUM restored hERG trafficking in three out of five variants, mirroring the clinical observations.

CONCLUSIONS:
Short-term LUM therapy is safe and yields a significant QTc shortening in LQT2 patients with a trafficking defect. Concordance between cellular and clinical findings reinforces the value of a mechanism-based, variant-informed approach and supports the feasibility of trafficking-correction strategies within a precision-medicine framework for inherited arrhythmia syndromes.
papers.titleJa: QT延長症候群2型における輸送異常を標的とする：患者特異的な細胞検証を伴う第2相臨床研究
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】および目的: QT 延長症候群 (LQTS) の主な構成要素は、KCNH2 の病原性変異による LQT2 であり、これは頻繁に輸送欠陥を引き起こしる。治療管理の進歩にもかかわらず、メカニズムを標的とした治療に対する臨床上のニーズは満たされていません。患者特異的なヒト人工多能性幹細胞由来心筋細胞（hiPSC-CM）を用いて、現在嚢胞性線維症に使用されているルマカトール（LUM）がhERG輸送を部分的に修正できることが以前に示されている。 LUM が LQT2 の QTc を短縮できるかどうかを判断するために、単群フェーズ 2 試験が実施した (観察研究・その他 / 症例数: 不明)
【方法】遺伝子的に輸送欠陥KCNH2変異体が確認された成人患者16名が登録された。参加者は入院し、連続遠隔測定下で 7 日間 LUM の投与を受けました。 QTc は、連続心電図と 12 誘導ホルター記録で定量化された。機構的な相関関係を調べるために、異なる遺伝子変異を持つ最初の 5 人の参加者から hiPSC-CM を生成し、hERG の成熟と輸送について評価しました
【結果】全体として、lumacaftor は有意な QTc 短縮をもたらしました (P < 0.001)。患者ごとの変化は平均 31 ± 21 ミリ秒であった。ベースライン QTc が 500 ミリ秒以上の患者が最も大きな効果を示し、75% が 40 ミリ秒以上の減少を達成しました。心室性不整脈は発生せず、副作用は主に胃腸であり、自然に限定された。 hiPSC-CM では、LUM は 5 つの変異体のうち 3 つで hERG 輸送を回復させ、臨床観察を反映しました
【結論】短期 LUM 療法は安全であり、輸送欠陥のある LQT2 患者において大幅な QTc 短縮をもたらしる

papers.title: Sphingomyelin as a key negative mediator in atrial fibrillation via lipid proﬁling analysis and functional identiﬁcation.
papers.journal: Europace : European pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac electrophysiology : journal of the working groups on cardiac pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac cellular electrophysiology of the European Society of Cardiology
papers.authors: Wang L, Shi A, Yu D, Jiang Z, Chen Q, Yu X, et al.
papers.citation: Wang L, Shi A, Yu D, Jiang Z, Chen Q, Yu X, et al.. Sphingomyelin as a key negative mediator in atrial fibrillation via lipid proﬁling analysis and functional identiﬁcation.. Europace. 2026 Sep 21;:. doi: 10.1093/europace/euag270 doi.
papers.abstract:
AIMS:
Atrial fibrillation (AF) has emerged as one of the most prevalent cardiac arrhythmias globally, with its incidence continuously rising, thereby elevating it to a major public health concern. The heart is known for its high lipid content, and disorders or abnormalities in lipid metabolism are frequently associated with cardiovascular diseases. This study aims to investigate the regulatory roles of lipids in AF.

METHODS AND RESULTS:
Using tree-based ensemble learning-assisted lipidomics, sphingomyelin was identified as a key differential metabolite and found to be significantly reduced in AF patients. Exogenous supplementation of sphingomyelin significantly attenuated Ach-CaCl2- and Ang II-induced AF, fibrosis, and inflammation in mice. Furthermore, decreased sphingomyelin levels were attributed to increased activity of sphingomyelin phosphodiesterases (SMPDs) under AF conditions. Mechanistically, RNA-Seq analysis demonstrated that sphingomyelin inhibits AF-induced activation of the Rap1 signaling pathway, a finding corroborated by overexpression and knockdown of RAP1 in vivo.

CONCLUSION:
Together, these findings highlight the therapeutic potential of sphingomyelin and SMPD inhibitors in mitigating AF through inhibition of the Rap1 signaling pathway, thereby establishing the targeting of sphingomyelin metabolism as a viable and novel treatment strategy for AF.
papers.titleJa: 脂質プロファイリング分析と機能同定による、心房細動における重要なネガティブメディエーターとしてのスフィンゴミエリン
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】心房細動 (AF) は、世界的に最も蔓延している不整脈の 1 つとして浮上しており、その発生率は継続的に増加しており、それにより公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項にまで高まっている (観察研究・その他 / 症例数: 不明)
【方法】そして
【結果】ツリーベースのアンサンブル学習支援リピドミクスを使用して、スフィンゴミエリンが重要な差次的代謝産物として同定され、AF 患者では大幅に減少していることが判明しました。スフィンゴミエリンの外因性補給は、マウスにおける Ach-CaCl2 および Ang II 誘発性の AF、線維症、炎症を大幅に軽減しました。さらに、スフィンゴミエリンレベルの低下は、AF条件下でのスフィンゴミエリンホスホジエステラーゼ（SMPD）の活性の増加に起因すると考えられました。機構的には、RNA-Seq解析により、スフィンゴミエリンがAF誘発性のRap1シグナル伝達経路の活性化を阻害することが実証され、この所見は生体内でのRAP1の過剰発現とノックダウンによって裏付けられた
【結論】まとめると、これらの発見は、Rap1 シグナル伝達経路の阻害を通じて心房細動を軽減するスフィンゴミエリンおよび SMPD 阻害剤の治療可能性を強調し、それによってスフィンゴミエリン代謝の標的化が実行可能かつ新規な心房細動治療戦略として確立されることになる

papers.abstract: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has been increasingly used for ventricular ablation. We present a novel case describing use of a variable-loop circular PFA catheter (Varipulse, Biosense Webster, Inc., Irvine, CA, USA) via a retrograde aortic approach for left ventricular ventricular tachycardia ablation. Retrograde aortic access was achieved using a long sheath (Ventrax system, Merit Medical, South Jordan, UT) permitting safe unsheathing and manipulation of the variable-loop PFA catheter to avoid entrapment with the mitral valve apparatus. The procedure was completed without complication and no VT recurrence was observed over 3 months follow-up. This case highlights the feasibility of this approach and expands the potential applications of this integrated PFA platform beyond its current indication for atrial fibrillation ablation.

papers.title: Beyond one-size-fits-all: personalized selection of contemporary implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapies.
papers.journal: Europace : European pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac electrophysiology : journal of the working groups on cardiac pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac cellular electrophysiology of the European Society of Cardiology
papers.authors: Ziacchi M, Boriani G, Biffi M
papers.citation: Ziacchi M, Boriani G, Biffi M. Beyond one-size-fits-all: personalized selection of contemporary implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapies.. Europace. 2026 Oct 01;28(10):. doi: 10.1093/europace/euag200 doi.
papers.abstract: Since the first human implantation in 1980, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) have transformed the prevention of sudden cardiac death. Today, multiple ICD platforms are available, each with distinct strengths and limitations, making individualized device selection essential to optimize outcomes and minimize complications. The transvenous ICD remains the most established technology, offering reliable defibrillation, antitachycardia pacing (ATP), and pacing support, but is limited by lead-related complications and infection risk. The subcutaneous ICD avoids intravascular leads and is particularly attractive in younger patients and those at high risk of infection, although it lacks ATP and has shorter device longevity. The extravascular ICD is an emerging alternative designed to combine the advantages of both systems by providing ATP and shock therapy without intravascular leads, though implantation is more complex and long-term evidence remains limited. Given these differences, ICD selection should be guided by patient-specific clinical characteristics rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. Key determinants include pacing indication, prior lead failure, infection risk, body mass index, age, and arrhythmic substrate. The proposed clinical pathway offers a practical framework to support tailored ICD selection by integrating these variables into a structured decision-making process. Such an individualized approach may improve patient outcomes, reduce device-related complications, and enhance the appropriate adoption of contemporary ICD technologies.

papers.abstractJa: 1980 年に初めて人体に埋め込まれて以来、植込み型除細動器 (ICD) は心臓突然死の予防に大きな変化をもたらしてきました。  現在、複数の ICD プラットフォームが利用可能であり、それぞれに異なる長所と制限があるため、結果を最適化し、合併症を最小限に抑えるには、個別のデバイスの選択が不可欠となっています。  経静脈 ICD は依然として最も確立された技術であり、信頼性の高い除細動、抗頻脈ペーシング (ATP)、およびペーシングのサポートを提供しますが、リード関連の合併症や感染リスクによって限界があります。  皮下 ICD は血管内リードを回避し、ATP が欠如しておりデバイスの寿命が短いものの、若い患者や感染リスクの高い患者にとって特に魅力的です。 血管外 ICD は、血管内リードなしで ATP とショック療法を提供することで両方のシステムの利点を組み合わせるように設計された新たな代替品ですが、移植はより複雑であり、長期的な証拠は依然として限られています。  これらの違いを考慮すると、ICD の選択は、画一的なアプローチではなく、患者固有の臨床的特徴に基づいて行う必要があります。  主要な決定要因には、ペーシングの指示、以前のリード故障、感染リスク、BMI、年齢、不整脈の基質が含まれます。  提案されたクリニカルパスウェイは、これらの変数を構造化された意思決定プロセスに統合することにより、カスタマイズされた ICD の選択をサポートする実用的なフレームワークを提供します。 このような個別化されたアプローチは、患者の転帰を改善し、デバイス関連の合併症を軽減し、最新の ICD 技術の適切な導入を強化する可能性があります。

papers.title: Antisense-mediated gene therapy targeting DMPK restores cardiac ion channel function and electrical stability in myotonic dystrophy type 1.
papers.authors: Pierre M, Sourisseau F, Jauvin D, Pouliot V, Carrer M, Jafar-Nejad P, et al.
papers.citation: Pierre M, Sourisseau F, Jauvin D, Pouliot V, Carrer M, Jafar-Nejad P, et al.. Antisense-mediated gene therapy targeting DMPK restores cardiac ion channel function and electrical stability in myotonic dystrophy type 1.. Heart Rhythm. 2026 Oct 04;23(10):e2543-e2554. doi: 10.1016/j.hrthm.2026.06.003 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND:
Myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) is characterized by toxic RNA gain of function leading to cardiac conduction defects and life-threatening arrhythmias. Current therapeutic options remain limited.

OBJECTIVE:
We evaluated the molecular and electrophysiological efficacy of IONIS-486178, an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) targeting mutant DMPK transcripts in human-induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) generated from a patient with DM1.

METHODS:
DM1 hiPSC-CMs were treated with IONIS-486178 for 24 hours. Efficacy was assessed using reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction for DMPK knockdown and splicing analysis, fluorescence in situ hybridization for nuclear foci quantification, western blot for ion channel protein expression, and whole-cell patch clamp for ionic currents and action potential characterization.

RESULTS:
Treatment of hiPSC-CMs with IONIS-486178 (5 μmol/L) achieved ∼90% DMPK knockdown, reduced toxic nuclear foci, and corrected SCN5A mis-splicing toward the adult isoform. Functionally, IONIS-486178 fully restored all ionic currents (sodium, L-type calcium, and potassium currents) reduced in DM1 hiPSC-CMs. This electrophysiological rescue correlated with re-expression of the corresponding ion channel proteins. The treatment also normalized action potential kinetics and durations and significantly reduced the incidence of arrhythmogenic events.

CONCLUSION:
ASO-mediated suppression of DMPK is sufficient to reverse core electrophysiological defects and reduce arrhythmogenic events in a human cellular model of DM1. These findings validate the biological rationale of targeting DMPK to prevent DM1-associated cardiac complications, supporting the continued development of next-generation ASO delivery platforms.

papers.authors: Xie D, Min W, Wang G, Zou Q, Zheng Q, Chen Z, et al.
papers.citation: Xie D, Min W, Wang G, Zou Q, Zheng Q, Chen Z, et al.. Cardiac α4β2 nicotinic receptors as a therapeutic target for fatal ventricular arrhythmias.. Eur Heart J. 2026 Sep 22;47(36):5094-5108. doi: 10.1093/eurheartj/ehag293 doi.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS:
Fatal ventricular tachyarrhythmias (FVTs) are a major cause of sudden cardiac death globally. Despite their clinical importance, current antiarrhythmic therapies remain constrained by limited efficacy and proarrhythmic risks. Although endogenous cardiac cholinergic signalling contributes to electrophysiological regulation, the therapeutic potential of targeting ventricular α4β2 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors (nAChRs), a pivotal component of this system, for FVT treatment remains to be elucidated.

METHODS:
A pharmacological screen identified positive allosteric modulators (PAMs) of α4β2 nAChRs as possessing antiarrhythmic properties. Through structure-based design, salvage-1 was developed and its efficacy and safety profile were evaluated in rodent, porcine, and human ex vivo heart models of FVTs. The underlying mechanism was investigated using patch-clamp electrophysiology, high-resolution optical mapping, and molecular dynamics simulations.

RESULTS:
Pharmacological screening validated the potentiation of α4β2 nAChRs as a promising antiarrhythmic strategy. Structure-guided development yielded salvage-1, a PAM that selectively engages Phe312 and Phe316 on the α4 subunit to stabilize the receptor in an open-channel state. Across rodent, porcine, and human ex vivo heart models of FVTs, salvage-1 consistently prevented arrhythmogenesis and rapidly restored sinus rhythm. Mechanistically, salvage-1 enhanced acetylcholine-gated currents, selectively improved conduction velocity in injured myocardium, and suppressed re-entry, without compromising electrophysiology in healthy tissue.

CONCLUSIONS:
This study identifies ventricular α4β2 nAChRs as a druggable target for FVTs and introduces salvage-1 as a first-in-class therapeutic candidate, thereby establishing a new direction for the pharmacological therapy of cardiac arrhythmias.
papers.titleJa: 致死性心室性不整脈の治療標的としての心臓α4β2ニコチン性受容体
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】および目的: 致死性心室頻脈性不整脈 (FVT) は、世界的に心臓突然死の主な原因となっている。現在の抗不整脈療法は、その臨床的重要性にもかかわらず、有効性が限られており、不整脈誘発のリスクがあるという制約が残っている。内因性心臓コリン作動性シグナル伝達は電気生理学的調節に寄与しているが、この系の重要な構成要素である心室α4β2ニコチン性アセチルコリン受容体（nAChR）を標的としたFVT治療の可能性はまだ解明されていない (観察研究・その他 / 症例数: 不明)
【方法】薬理学的スクリーニングにより、α4β2 nAChR のポジティブ アロステリック モジュレーター (PAM) が抗不整脈特性を有することが同定された。構造ベースの設計を通じて、サルベージ 1 が開発され、その有効性と安全性プロファイルが、げっ歯類、ブタ、およびヒトの FVT の ex vivo 心臓モデルで評価した。根底にあるメカニズムは、パッチクランプ電気生理学、高解像度光学マッピング、分子動力学シミュレーションを使用して調査された
【結果】薬理学的スクリーニングにより、α4β2 nAChR の増強が有望な抗不整脈戦略であることが確認した。構造誘導開発により、α4 サブユニット上の Phe312 と Phe316 に選択的に結合して受容体をオープンチャネル状態に安定化する PAM であるサルベージ 1 が得られました。げっ歯類、ブタ、およびヒトの FVT の ex vivo 心臓モデルにおいて、サルベージ 1 は一貫して不整脈の発生を防止し、洞調律を迅速に回復しました。機構的には、サルベージ 1 は、健康な組織の電気生理学を損なうことなく、アセチルコリン依存性電流を増強し、損傷した心筋の伝導速度を選択的に改善し、リエントリーを抑制しました
【結論】この研究は、心室α4β2 nAChRがFVTの創薬可能な標的であることを特定し、ファーストインクラスの治療候補としてサルベージ1を導入し、それによって心不整脈の薬物療法の新たな方向性を確立した

papers.titleJa: 焦点パルスフィールドエネルギーを使用した Para-His 大動脈周囲 VT アブレーション
papers.summaryJa:
【概要】ヒス束近傍・大動脈周囲の深部瘢痕に起因する心室頻拍 (VT) に対する焦点パルスフィールドアブレーション (PFA) の有用性と安全性の検証 (症例報告 (Case Report) / N = 1例)
【方法】従来の高周波 (RF) アブレーションでは伝導系傷害のリスクが高い基質に対し、心筋選択性を有する焦点 PFA カテーテルを用いたマッピングおよびエネルギー照射を実施した
【結果】房室伝導系への永続的傷害を回避しつつ、深部瘢痕由来の VT 標的電位を迅速かつ効果的に消失させ、急性期成功を達成した
【結論】伝導系に隣接する Para-His 大動脈周囲 VT 基質において、焦点 PFA は安全かつ有効な新しいアブレーション治療選択肢となり得る
papers.abstractJa:
【背景】
中隔流出領域（Para-His・大動脈周囲）から発生する心室頻拍（VT）のカテーテルアブレーションは、病変基質が深部に位置し瘢痕化している上、刺激伝導系に近接しているため極めて難易度が高い。従来のラジオ波（RF）アブレーションでは通電エンドポイントが不明瞭であり、房室ブロックなどの主要合併症リスクが高い。不可逆的エレクトロポレーションを利用したパルスフィールドアブレーション（PFA）は、心筋選択性が高く隣接組織への副損傷を抑えて深部病変を形成できる新しいエネルギー源として注目されている。

【方法】
ヒス束・大動脈周囲の深部瘢痕に由来する難治性心室頻拍患者に対し、高密度三次元マッピングシステムおよび焦点型 PFA カテーテルを用いて心室内マッピングとアブレーションを実施した。局所電位の変化および伝導系への影響をモニタリングしながら PFA 通電プロトコルを行った。

【結果】
焦点 PFA 通電により、ヒス束近傍の危険領域においても伝導系（房室伝導・ヒス束電位）への永続的障害を生じさせることなく、目標とする VT の発生源および瘢痕部局所電位を迅速かつ完全に消失させ、急性期成功を達成した。

【結論】
伝導系に近接する Para-His 大動脈周囲の複雑な心室頻拍基質に対し、焦点 PFA は高い解剖学的選択性と治療効果を発揮し、従来のラジオ波アブレーションに代わる安全で有望なアプローチであることが示された
